clue.text: Beat using stick

definitions.meaning: to beat someone is to thrash them, an old sense of the verb used in 'give him a pasting'
a glue used for sticking paper, as in wallpaper adhesive

explanation.surface: Someone hits out with a cane.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: thrash soundly, and the adhesive used to fix paper.

clue.text: Start out to look quickly inside ancient manuscript

indicators.note: inside says the trimmed glance word sits within the word for ancient

parts.note: ancient means past, of bygone times

indicators.note: the start of the word goes out, so its opening letter is dropped

parts.note: to look quickly is to glimpse

explanation.surface: Instructions to begin by glancing into an old manuscript.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Start out' drops the opening letter, leaving LIMPSE; 'look quickly' reads as an instruction to the solver but is the glance word itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A palimpsest is a parchment manuscript scraped and written over again.

clue.text: Settled a way round

indicators.note: round says the street abbreviation goes around the single letter

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
taken as written

explanation.surface: Something came to rest after going round a road.
explanation.definitionFit: Sat is a past tense meaning came to rest or was placed, as a bird settles on a branch.

clue.text: Cut out drill without hesitation

indicators.note: without means the hesitation sound is taken out of the drill word

parts.note: a drill is a practice routine, an exercise
ER is the sound of a hesitation in speech

explanation.surface: An instruction to stop a training drill with no dithering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes ER from EXERCISE, leaving EXCISE.
explanation.definitionFit: To excise is to remove surgically or delete, to cut away.

clue.text: Low accommodation, in a fashion, with little room

parts.note: a cell is a small room, as in a prison or monastery
a rage is a craze, the fashion of the moment, as in 'all the rage'

explanation.surface: A basement flat, done up stylishly though cramped.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces go in answer order: CELL, then A, then RAGE. 'Low' points to storage below ground level.
explanation.definitionFit: Cellarage is cellar space, room for storage underground.

clue.text: Revolutionary organisation has business manager initially put in prison

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a business

indicators.note: initially asks for only the opening letter of the word manager

parts.note: to intern is to confine or imprison, especially in wartime

explanation.surface: A radical group whose boss was jailed at first.
explanation.walkthrough: The Comintern was the Communist International, founded in Moscow in 1919.
explanation.definitionFit: The Communist International was a body set up to spread world revolution.

clue.text: Stagger from place where one may be left in trouble

definitions.text: place where one may be left in trouble
definitions.meaning: from the idiom about being abandoned in a difficulty: left in the ...

explanation.surface: Someone reels away from a spot where they were abandoned.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden unsteady movement, and the idiomatic plight of a deserted person.

clue.text: Broadcasts are a must for those wanting play purely for enjoyment

definitions.text: those wanting play purely for enjoyment

indicators.note: to broadcast is to scatter seed widely, so these letters are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: Radio programmes are essential for people who play only for fun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Broadcasts' looks like radio, but it is the anagram signal for ARE A MUST.
explanation.definitionFit: Amateurs play sport for love rather than money, unlike professionals.

clue.text: Insensitivity shown when one is put out

definitions.text: Insensitivity shown when one is put out

parts.words: Insensitivity shown when one is put out
parts.note: being put out sounds like being annoyed, but here means knocked unconscious for an operation, when feeling is lost

explanation.definitionFit: Anaesthesia is loss of sensation, induced when a patient is put under for surgery.

clue.text: In Baltimore we root for the pitcher

indicators.note: In says the letters lie inside the run of words Baltimore we root

explanation.surface: A Baltimore fan cheers on the baseball pitcher.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pitcher' suggests baseball, but it is a jug.
explanation.definitionFit: A ewer is a large jug, a vessel for pouring water.

clue.text: This Johnny could show more eclat

indicators.note: could show means the letters of more eclat could be made to display another word when rearranged

explanation.surface: Some fellow could put on more of a show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Johnny' points to the phrase Johnny-come-lately, someone who arrives late.
explanation.definitionFit: A Johnny-come-lately is a newcomer, a person who arrives behind time.

clue.text: Quartz found in a mountain pass

parts.note: a gate is an old word for a narrow pass or gap in hills

explanation.surface: A crystal discovered in a mountain gap.
explanation.definitionFit: Agate is a banded variety of chalcedony, a form of quartz.

clue.text: Movable feasts for elderly waiters

parts.note: movable feasts sounds like church festivals; here they are dinners delivered by van to old people who wait at home for them

explanation.definitionFit: A British service delivering hot meals to the elderly and housebound at home.

clue.text: Fitting pocket

definitions.meaning: to pocket is to take for oneself, to steal

explanation.surface: Something suitable for a pocket.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: suitable as an adjective, and to seize as a verb.

clue.text: Presumably it can throw light on the other side

definitions.text: Presumably it can throw light on the other side

parts.words: Presumably it can throw light on the other side
parts.note: a burner fuelled by alcohol is read as one that lights up the afterlife, home of ghosts

explanation.definitionFit: A lamp burning methylated spirit or alcohol; a spirit is also a ghost from beyond.

clue.text: August follower of Irish clan

definitions.meaning: a clan or family division, especially in Ireland

explanation.surface: A devotee of something grand from an Irish family.
explanation.definitionFit: The abbreviation for the ninth month, and a word for a Celtic family group.

clue.text: Belonging to second joint on leg, for example

indicators.note: on means the second and joint pieces are placed after the leg piece

parts.note: a leg is a limb, a member of the body
the hip is a joint

explanation.surface: A second joint attached to a leg is part of the body.
explanation.definitionFit: Membership is the state of belonging to a group or society.

clue.text: Push particular goods — they help to raise sales, we hear

definitions.text: they help to raise sales, we hear

parts.note: to bunt is to push or butt
a line is a particular range of goods, as in a new line in shoes

explanation.surface: Promoting certain products helps boost sales.
explanation.walkthrough: 'we hear' turns sales into sails: buntlines are ropes for hauling up a square sail.
explanation.definitionFit: Buntlines are ropes on a square-rigged ship used to haul up the foot of a sail.

clue.text: Male worker concealing name still

indicators.note: concealing says the male and worker pieces hold the name abbreviation inside them

parts.note: a stag is a male deer
an ant is the crossword's usual worker

explanation.surface: A man at work keeps his name quiet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'still' reads as an adverb meaning yet or even so; it is the adjective meaning motionless.
explanation.definitionFit: Stagnant water is still, not flowing.

clue.text: Cook's fat, and getting more dumpy

definitions.meaning: fat such as lard used by a cook in pastry

explanation.surface: A cook is plump and getting plumper.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: fat used in baking, and growing shorter in stature.

clue.text: Drug addict's employer

definitions.meaning: someone who employs, that is makes use of, a thing

explanation.surface: Someone who hires a junkie.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: a person who takes drugs, and one who employs or utilises something.

clue.text: Thwarted, being in a place without parking

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the placed word goes around the parking letter

parts.note: sited means located, being in a place

explanation.surface: Frustrated at being somewhere with nowhere to park.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like lacking, but means outside here.
explanation.definitionFit: To spite someone is to thwart or frustrate them out of malice.

clue.text: Jumbo set aside — it's viciously difficult!

definitions.text: Jumbo set aside — it's viciously difficult!

parts.words: Jumbo set aside — it's viciously difficult!
parts.note: jumbo means a large beast set apart from its herd, which becomes savage and hard to handle

explanation.definitionFit: A wild animal living apart from the herd and dangerously aggressive.

clue.text: To succeed. English knight has to go to law

parts.note: N is the chess notation for knight
to sue is to take legal action

explanation.surface: An English knight must go to court in order to win.
explanation.definitionFit: To ensue is to follow on, to come next.

clue.text: In the sound, notices a cutter

indicators.note: in the sound says the word for notices is heard, not seen, giving a word that sounds alike

parts.note: ads are advertisements, notices

explanation.surface: Someone spots a boat in a stretch of water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' and 'cutter' suggest a sea channel and a boat; a cutter here is a tool.
explanation.definitionFit: An adze is a cutting tool with an arched blade set at right angles to the handle.

clue.text: Drop a theatrical piece

parts.note: a dram is a small drop of spirits

explanation.surface: An instruction to abandon a stage play.
explanation.definitionFit: A drama is a play for the stage.

clue.text: School places for those needing remedial treatment

definitions.text: School places for those needing remedial treatment

parts.words: School places for those needing remedial treatment
parts.note: remedial suggests slow learners, but these rooms are where sick pupils are nursed

explanation.definitionFit: Sickrooms in a boarding school, or institutions where invalids recover.

clue.text: Scene of carnival and endless wild revelry

indicators.note: endless means the final letter of the revelry word is cut off

parts.note: a riot is a bout of wild revelry

explanation.surface: A carnival city famed for wild partying.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' drops the T from RIOT. Rio de Janeiro's carnival is world-famous.
explanation.definitionFit: Rio de Janeiro hosts the most famous carnival in the world.

clue.text: Title for Sophia — one making her cross?

definitions.meaning: Sophia of Hanover held the rank given to the wife of a German prince entitled to elect the Holy Roman Emperor
a woman voting, who marks a cross on her ballot paper

explanation.surface: A royal woman and a female voter.
explanation.definitionFit: A princely rank held by Sophia of Hanover, and fancifully a woman who elects.

clue.text: Become dejected listening to Olive, say

indicators.note: listening to means we hear the word for olive, say, rather than read it

parts.note: an olive is an example of a drupe, a stone fruit

explanation.surface: Someone grows glum hearing from a woman named Olive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Olive' looks like a woman's name; it is the fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: To droop is to sag or flag in spirits.
